frequency_question: How often do states with declared intent and technical partnerships successfully initiate domestic assembly lines for complex cruise missiles or equivalent standoff weapons within 24 to 36 months?
membership_rule: Includes sovereign states attempting to localize production of advanced Western or equivalent high-tech guided weapons during active high-intensity conflict.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic localization of Western artillery ammunition (Rheinmetall joint ventures)
Ukraine domestic production ramp of Neptune cruise missiles
Ukraine localization of foreign drone platforms (various Western/regional JV initiatives)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named cases representing wartime emergency defense localization initiatives in Ukraine.
known_gaps: Excludes classified bilateral missile-sharing agreements whose production timelines are unverified by public defense media.
skeleton: 3 localization efforts tracked, 3 operational milestones achieved within the compressed wartime window.
validity_reason: Wartime urgency and industrial adaptation baselines remain consistent through the target window.
